The '''Circle Chambers''' were inside a stained-[[Glass/Legends|glass]] dome in the [[Kesh capitol building|capitol building]] of [[Tahv]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It was in these chambers that the [[Circle of Lords]], the ruling council of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], convened.
